title: [M1-01] Scaffold apps/api FastAPI service (settings, DB pool, health, migrations runner, tests)
body:
## Description
Create the Python backend `apps/api` (package `ujc_api`, uv project, Python 3.12) that later issues build on.
Touch **only** `apps/api/**` (no root files, no apps/web) so this runs in parallel with M2-01.

- `apps/api/pyproject.toml`: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic-settings, psycopg[binary,pool], httpx; dev: pytest, ruff (same ruff config as apps/crawler: line-length 100, py312, select E,F,W,I,B,UP,SIM). Add `job_crawler` as an editable path dependency (`[tool.uv.sources] job_crawler = { path = "../crawler", editable = true }`).
- `src/ujc_api/settings.py` (pydantic-settings; variable names in ARCHITECTURE §10; loads repo-root `.env.local` in development only).
- `src/ujc_api/db.py`: psycopg `ConnectionPool` (min 1, max 5), `get_conn` FastAPI dependency.
- `src/ujc_api/migrate.py`: `python -m ujc_api.migrate` applies `db/migrations/*.sql` in name order, one transaction each, recorded in `schema_migrations` (same semantics as `scripts/migrate.mjs`, so both can coexist).
- `src/ujc_api/logging.py`: JSON logs, `X-Request-ID` middleware (accept incoming or generate uuid4), access log without query strings.
- `src/ujc_api/main.py`: `create_app()`, error handler producing `{error:{code,message,fields?}}`, routers `GET /api/health` and `GET /api/ready` (DB `SELECT 1` + no pending migrations: 200, else 503). OpenAPI at `/api/openapi.json` + docs only when `UJC_ENV != production`.
- `tests/conftest.py`: session fixture creating a fresh schema in the `TEST_DATABASE_URL` database (skip DB tests with a clear message if unset), applying all migrations; `client` fixture using FastAPI `TestClient`.
- `apps/api/README.md`: run (`uv sync`, `uv run uvicorn ujc_api.main:app --reload --port 8000`), test, migrate.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` pass in apps/api
- [ ] `GET /api/health` returns 200 `{status:'ok', version}`; `GET /api/ready` returns 200 with DB and 503 when the DB is unreachable (tested with a bad URL)
- [ ] `python -m ujc_api.migrate` applies 001-006 on an empty DB and is a no-op on the second run (test)
- [ ] Unknown route returns 404 in the standard error shape; unhandled exception returns 500 without a stack trace in the body
- [ ] Every response carries `X-Request-ID`; logs are JSON lines with request id, method, path, status, duration
- [ ] No secrets in code; `.env.local` is only read when `UJC_ENV=development`

## Dependencies
- none

## Notes
Use the FastAPI app-factory pattern so tests can build an app with overridden settings.

## Parallel work
Lane `A`: can run concurrently with issues in other lanes (see docs/product/README.md). **Start first**, in parallel with the other kickoff issue (M1-01 / M2-01).

Refs: docs/product/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/product/PRD.md, docs/product/E2E_FLOW.md

title: [M1-02] Users, sessions & CSRF: register / login / logout / me / change password
body:
## Description
Add accounts with server-side sessions. Migration **`db/migrations/007_users_auth.sql`** exactly as ARCHITECTURE §4 (users, sessions, email_tokens).

- `ujc_api/auth/passwords.py`: argon2id via `argon2-cffi` (`PasswordHasher()`), `check_needs_rehash` on login, min length 10, reject the top-1000 common passwords (bundled list file).
- `ujc_api/auth/sessions.py`: create (32 random bytes, store sha256), lookup (update `last_seen_at`, slide `expires_at` at most once an hour), revoke one / all for a user.
- `ujc_api/auth/csrf.py`: double-submit; `ujc_csrf` cookie (random, not HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax) set by `GET /api/auth/me` and login/register; middleware rejects POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE carrying a session cookie but a missing/mismatched `X-CSRF-Token` (403 `csrf_failed`). Bearer-token requests are exempt.
- `ujc_api/auth/deps.py`: `current_user` (401 `unauthenticated`), `optional_user`.
- `routers/auth.py`: `POST /api/auth/register` (`{email,password,displayName?,acceptTerms}`, 201, sets cookies), `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me`, `POST /api/auth/change-password` (revokes other sessions). `routers/me.py`: `GET/PATCH /api/me/settings` (displayName, country ISO from the packages/core list, IANA timezone, locale en|vi).
- Cookie `ujc_session`: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Secure when `UJC_ENV=production`, Max-Age from `UJC_SESSION_DAYS`.
- In-process rate limiter `ujc_api/ratelimit.py` (token bucket keyed by string; injectable clock for tests): login 10/min/IP + 5/min/email, register 5/hour/IP, returning 429 + `Retry-After`.
- CORS middleware only for `UJC_CORS_ORIGINS`, with credentials.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Migration 007 applies cleanly after 001-006
- [ ] Register returns 201, stores an argon2id hash, sets `ujc_session` (HttpOnly) and `ujc_csrf` cookies
- [ ] Wrong password returns 401 `invalid_credentials` with the same message as an unknown email; a hash is always computed (no timing oracle)
- [ ] Logout deletes the session row; the old cookie then gets 401
- [ ] Mutating request without the CSRF header gets 403; with it, OK; Bearer requests exempt
- [ ] Change password revokes all other sessions (test)
- [ ] Rate limits return 429 with Retry-After (tests use a fake clock)
- [ ] Passwords, tokens and cookies never appear in logs (test captures logs)
- [ ] Coverage of `ujc_api/auth` at least 90%

## Dependencies
- M1-01

## Parallel work
Lane `A`: can run concurrently with issues in other lanes (see docs/product/README.md).

Refs: docs/product/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/product/PRD.md, docs/product/E2E_FLOW.md

title: [M1-03] Email verification & password reset with pluggable mailer
body:
## Description
- `ujc_api/mail.py`: `Mailer` protocol; `ConsoleMailer` (logs subject + links; dev/test), `MemoryMailer` (tests) and `SmtpMailer` (stdlib `smtplib` + STARTTLS, `SMTP_*`, `MAIL_FROM`); chosen by `UJC_MAILER`. Plain-text + simple HTML templates in `ujc_api/templates/email/`.
- Tokens in `email_tokens` (sha256 stored): `verify_email` 24 h, `reset_password` 1 h, single use.
- Endpoints: `POST /api/auth/verify-email {token}`, `POST /api/auth/resend-verification` (session; 3/hour), `POST /api/auth/forgot-password {email}` (always 202; 3/hour/email), `POST /api/auth/reset-password {token,newPassword}` (revokes all sessions).
- Registration (M1-02) now sends the verification email. Links use `UJC_PUBLIC_URL` + SPA routes `/verify-email?token=` and `/reset-password?token=`.
- `GET /api/auth/me` includes `emailVerified: boolean`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Register triggers exactly one verification email (MemoryMailer)
- [ ] Valid token sets `email_verified_at`; reused or expired token returns 400 `token_invalid`
- [ ] Forgot-password for an unknown email returns 202 and sends nothing; for a known email sends one link
- [ ] Reset password changes the hash, marks the token used, deletes all sessions
- [ ] SmtpMailer unit-tested against a stub SMTP server

## Dependencies
- M1-02

## Parallel work
Lane `A`: can run concurrently with issues in other lanes (see docs/product/README.md).

Refs: docs/product/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/product/PRD.md, docs/product/E2E_FLOW.md

title: [M1-04] Ownership & visibility migration (multi-user data model)
body:
## Description

title: [M1-06] Jobs, profile results & sources read API
body:
## Description
Port the SQL in `apps/web/src/lib/jobs.ts` (`listJobs`, `sourceStatuses`) to `ujc_api/repos/jobs.py`, adding the visibility rule and the pagination envelope.

- `GET /api/jobs?q&source&remote&page` (optional auth): public catalogue + own jobs when signed in; FTS ranking with `websearch_to_tsquery('english', q)`.
- `GET /api/jobs/{id}`: includes `description` (plain text); 404 if not visible.
- `GET /api/profiles/{id}/jobs?q&source&remote&minScore&cvId&page`: the profile's rules (keywords, locations, remote, sources, linked `profile_jobs`, open_to vs candidate country with unknown kept), left join `cv_matches` for `cvId` (default: the user's latest ready CV, if the table has a `status` column; otherwise latest). Sort: score desc nulls last, ts_rank (+0.1 for linked jobs), date. Status filter and the `application` field are added by M4-05.
- `GET /api/sources`: catalogue (id, label, kind, homepage, attribution text) + latest global run per source + total jobs.
- DTO `Job` = packages/core `Job` shape (+ `description` on detail).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Response shapes match ARCHITECTURE §5 and packages/core `Job` (snapshot test of JSON keys)
- [ ] Signed-out `/api/jobs` never returns owned jobs; signed-in returns public + own only
- [ ] Profile results honour locations, remoteOnly, sources and candidate country; tests ported from current web behaviour
- [ ] Pagination: pageSize 50, correct total
- [ ] `apps/api/scripts/bench_jobs.py` seeds 100k jobs; q queries use `jobs_search_idx` (EXPLAIN) and p95 is under 500 ms locally

title: [M1-07] Postgres task queue, worker process & scheduler
body:
## Description
Background jobs without extra infrastructure. Migration **`db/migrations/009_tasks.sql`** (ARCHITECTURE §4). New files only under `apps/api/src/ujc_api/tasks/` and `worker.py` (does not edit routers), so it runs in parallel with M1-02..M1-06.

- `tasks/queue.py`: `enqueue(conn, kind, payload, user_id=None, dedupe_key=None, run_after=None) -> task_id` (returns the existing active task on dedupe conflict), `claim(conn, worker_id)` with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, `complete`, `fail` (backoff 30 s * 2^n until max_attempts), `set_progress`, `requeue_stale(older_than=30 min)`.
- `tasks/registry.py`: `@handler("kind")` decorator; handlers receive `(conn, task)`.
- `tasks/scheduler.py`: every minute, enqueue due periodic tasks with dedupe keys: `global_crawl` daily 22:00 UTC (handler calls `job_crawler.cli.run_source` for each source + `profile_search.run` for all profiles), `purge` hourly (expired sessions/email tokens if the tables exist).
- `worker.py`: `python -m ujc_api.worker [--once] [--concurrency N]`; graceful SIGTERM (stop claiming, finish the current task up to 60 s, else put it back to `queued`); also runs the scheduler loop (advisory lock so only one process schedules).
- `GET /api/tasks/{id}` router is added by M3-05 (needs auth); not in this issue.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two workers never run the same task (concurrency test with two connections)
- [ ] Dedupe: enqueuing an active dedupe_key returns the existing id
- [ ] A failing task retries with backoff, then ends `failed` with the error after max_attempts
- [ ] A stale running task is requeued
- [ ] `--once` processes one task and exits (used by tests)
- [ ] Scheduler enqueues exactly one `global_crawl` per day even when two processes tick every minute

## Dependencies
- M1-01

## Parallel work
Lane `E`: can run concurrently with issues in other lanes (see docs/product/README.md).

Refs: docs/product/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/product/PRD.md, docs/product/E2E_FLOW.md

title: [M2-01] Convert apps/web to a static-export SPA with typed API client and public jobs page
body:
## Description
Turn the web app into a client-side SPA that talks only to the API (contract: ARCHITECTURE §3 and §5). Touch **only** `apps/web/**` and `packages/core/**` (no apps/api) so this runs in parallel with M1-01. First read `apps/web/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/static-exports.md` and `single-page-applications.md`.

- `next.config.ts`: `output: 'export'`, `trailingSlash: true`, `images: { unoptimized: true }`; remove `cacheComponents`, `partialPrefetching` and the `.env.local` loader for DATABASE_URL.
- `apps/web/package.json`: remove `postgres`, `server-only`; build script `next build` (no migrate); add `vitest`, `@testing-library/react`, `jsdom`; script `test`.
- Delete `src/lib/db.ts`, `src/lib/jobs.ts`, `src/lib/profiles.ts`, `src/app/profiles/**` (rebuilt in M2-03), `src/app/api/health/route.ts`.
- `packages/core/src/api.ts`: DTO types (`Page<T>`, `ApiErrorBody`, `User`, `SearchProfile`, `ProfileInput`, `SourceInfo`, `TaskStatus`, `JobDetail`), exported from the index.
- `src/lib/api.ts`: `apiFetch<T>(path, init)` with base URL from `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` (default ''), `credentials: 'include'`, CSRF header from the `ujc_csrf` cookie on unsafe methods, JSON parsing, `ApiError` (status, code, message, fields), pluggable 401 handler; typed wrappers `getJobs`, `getJob`, `getSources`.
- `src/lib/use-api.ts`: minimal data hook (loading/error/data/reload), or TanStack Query; record the choice in ARCHITECTURE §3.
- App shell `src/app/layout.tsx` (nav placeholders, footer with source attributions incl. "Jobs by Adzuna"); `src/app/page.tsx` client page: search box, source filter, remote toggle, pagination (state in URL via `useSearchParams` inside `<Suspense>`), `JobCard` list, source status strip, loading skeleton, empty and error states.
- `src/app/jobs/view/page.tsx`: job detail by `?id=` (description rendered as text with line breaks).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `pnpm --filter web build` produces `apps/web/out/` with no server functions; `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm lint` pass
- [ ] No import of `postgres`, `server-only`, Server Actions or `next/headers` remains in apps/web
- [ ] Vitest: `apiFetch` adds the CSRF header only on unsafe methods, maps the error body to ApiError, calls the 401 handler; jobs page renders items from mocked fetch and shows empty/error states
- [ ] With `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000` the page calls `GET /api/jobs?...` and `GET /api/sources` (mocked fetch test)
- [ ] `apps/web/README.md` documents the SPA dev command

## Dependencies
- none

## Notes
The root README architecture section is updated later by M5-02 to avoid conflicts.

## Parallel work
Lane `B`: can run concurrently with issues in other lanes (see docs/product/README.md). **Start first**, in parallel with the other kickoff issue (M1-01 / M2-01).

title: [M3-03] Upwork GraphQL client library (fixture-tested, no API key needed)
body:
## Description
Pure library in `apps/crawler/src/job_crawler/sources/upwork.py`, **not** registered in `SOURCES` (no daily crawl: Upwork API Terms §4.1 forbid continuous monitoring).

- `UpworkClient(http, access_token)`: `search_jobs(expression, *, first=20, after=None, skill_expression=None, category_ids=None) -> UpworkPage`, calling `POST https://api.upwork.com/graphql` with `marketplaceJobPostingsSearch(marketPlaceJobFilter: {searchExpression_eq, skillExpression_eq, categoryIds_any, pagination_eq {after, first}}, searchType: ...)`. Keep the query text in `upwork_queries.py`; verify field and enum names against the official schema once the key is available.
- Map edges to `UpworkJob` (pydantic: id/ciphertext, title, description truncated to 4k chars, url `https://www.upwork.com/jobs/~<ciphertext>`, created_at, job type, budget/hourly text, skills, client country, payment verified). Deliberately **not** `JobRecord`, so it cannot be upserted into `jobs` by accident.
- OAuth helpers: `authorization_url(client_id, redirect_uri, state, code_challenge)`, `exchange_code(...)`, `refresh(...)`, PKCE `make_verifier()` / `challenge(verifier)`.
- Errors: `UpworkAuthError` (401), `UpworkRateLimited(retry_after)` (429), `UpworkError` (GraphQL `errors`). One retry with backoff on 429/5xx.

title: [M3-04] Upwork OAuth connect + user-directed live search with 24 h cache (behind UPWORK_ENABLED)
body:
## Description
Ships behind `UPWORK_ENABLED` (needs our approved Upwork API key; until then tests use mocks). Migration **`db/migrations/012_upwork_cache.sql`**.

API (`routers/upwork.py`):
- `GET /api/connections/upwork/authorize`: PKCE verifier + `state` bound to the session (short-lived server-side row), 302 to Upwork.
- `GET /api/connections/upwork/callback?code&state`: validate state, exchange the code, store tokens encrypted in `platform_connections` (platform `upwork`), 302 to `/connections?upwork=connected` (or `denied` / `error`).
- Refresh on demand when `expires_at` < now + 5 min; on refresh failure set status `error`.
- `POST /api/upwork/search {q?, profileId?, cursor?}`: q defaults to the profile keywords (`plain_keywords`); cache key = sha256(user, normalised query, cursor); serve from cache while `expires_at > now()`, else call Upwork and store with `expires_at = fetched_at + 24h`. Rate limit 30/hour/user. Response `{items, nextCursor, fetchedAt, expiresAt, attribution: 'Upwork'}`.
- `purge` task deletes expired cache rows; disconnect deletes tokens + cache.
- Guard tests: no scheduler entry for Upwork; `jobs` never gets source `upwork`; match scoring rejects Upwork.

Web: `src/components/upwork/UpworkPanel.tsx` on `/profiles/view` (only when available + connected): "Search Upwork now", results with "From Upwork" attribution and expiry time; "Save to tracker" posts a snapshot to `POST /api/applications` when M4-05 is merged (hidden otherwise).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Full OAuth flow tested with mocked Upwork endpoints, including state mismatch (400) and user denial
- [ ] A second identical search within 24 h does not call Upwork; after expiry it does (fake clock)
- [ ] Purge removes expired rows; disconnect removes tokens and cache
- [ ] Flag off: endpoints 404 and the panel is hidden
- [ ] Tokens never logged and stored encrypted
- [ ] Panel visually separates Upwork results from other sources and shows attribution

## Dependencies
- M3-01
- M3-03
- M2-03

## Notes
Before enabling in production, Tony obtains the API key and confirms the use case with Upwork (ARCHITECTURE §7 step 4).

## Parallel work

- `apps/api/Dockerfile`: multi-stage, python:3.12-slim, uv, `uv sync --locked --no-dev`, non-root user, `HEALTHCHECK` on `/api/health`; one image runs `api`, `worker` and `migrate` by command. The build context includes `apps/crawler` (path dependency).
- `apps/web/Dockerfile`: node:22 + pnpm build, then a `caddy:2` image serving `out/`.
- `deploy/Caddyfile`: `/api/*` to api:8000; SPA static with `try_files {path} {path}/ /index.html`; security headers (CSP `default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; frame-ancestors 'none'`, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy); compression; request body limit 6 MB.
- `deploy/docker-compose.yml`: postgres (dev profile), migrate (one-shot), api, worker, web; configuration from `deploy/.env` (git-ignored; committed `deploy/.env.example` lists names only).
- `e2e/` Playwright workspace package: sign up, skip onboarding, create a profile, results page renders (worker with `UJC_LLM_PROVIDER=fake`; network crawling disabled via `UJC_OFFLINE=1`, which seeds fixture jobs).
- CI job `e2e`: compose up, run Playwright, upload the trace on failure.
- Update the root README (layout, develop, deploy; Vercel not used for now; plan to retire the daily-crawl workflow once the worker scheduler runs).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up --build` serves the app on http://localhost:8080 with working signup
- [ ] Containers run as non-root; images contain no `.env` files
- [ ] Security headers present (curl check in CI)
- [ ] Playwright smoke passes in CI

title: [M5-03] Security hardening & observability
body:
## Description
- Rate limits: apply ARCHITECTURE §9 to every listed endpoint from one config; 429 body includes `retryAfter`.
- Request size limits per route; strict Pydantic models (`extra='forbid'`); job descriptions returned as plain text (HTML stripped server-side) to prevent stored XSS.
- CI: `pip-audit` and `pnpm audit --prod` (fail on high), `bandit` for apps/api.
- Optional Sentry (`SENTRY_DSN`) for api/worker with PII scrubbing (no emails, CV text or tokens); worker logs per task (kind, duration, outcome, LLM tokens).
- `GET /api/ready` also reports worker heartbeat age (the worker writes a heartbeat every 30 s); 503 if older than 5 min.
- Backups: `deploy/backup.sh` (pg_dump custom format, 14-day rotation) + `docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md` (restore drill, rotating `UJC_ENCRYPTION_KEYS`, incident response and 72 h breach notification).

title: [M5-04] Privacy & data rights: consents, export, account deletion, CV retention, legal pages
body:
## Description
Migration **`db/migrations/017_audit_privacy.sql`** (`audit_log`, `consents`). PRD §7: Vietnam PDP Law 91/2025/QH15 + Decree 356/2025/ND-CP, Australian Privacy Act (APPs).
- Consents: record `terms`, `privacy` (at register), `ai_processing` (first CV upload) and `digest_email` (settings) with a version; `DELETE /api/me/consents/{purpose}` withdraws; withdrawing `ai_processing` deletes CV text/extracted data + matches and blocks scoring.
- `GET /api/me/export` (JSON attachment; 3/day); `DELETE /api/me` (password + confirmation; cascade; best-effort Upwork token revoke; audit entry kept with user_id nulled).
- `purge` task: CVs unused for `UJC_CV_RETENTION_DAYS` get an email notice 7 days before, then are deleted; expired sessions, tokens and Upwork cache are removed.
- Audit log writes for the events in ARCHITECTURE §4 (replaces the `ujc_api/audit.py` placeholder).
- Web: `/settings` Privacy section (export, withdraw AI consent, delete account); `/privacy` and `/terms` content (data collected, purposes, processors: hosting, Anthropic (USA), SMTP provider; cross-border transfer; retention; rights; contact; runner and Upwork notes).
- `docs/ops/PRIVACY_OPERATIONS.md`: cross-border transfer impact assessment template (filed with the Ministry of Public Security, A05, within 60 days of the first transfer), record of processing, breach-response procedure (72 h).

- [ ] Deleting an account removes every row owned by the user (test enumerates all tables with user_id / owner_user_id)

title: [M3-09] Shared source clients for apps/mcp, apps/crawler and apps/api; SEEK via its JSON search API
body:
## Description
Idea from #1: query free APIs and feeds on demand instead of crawling job sites. Today the same sources are parsed twice: once in `apps/mcp/src/job_search_mcp/sources/{seek,wwr,arc}.py` and again in `apps/crawler/src/job_crawler/{sources,session}`.

- Create one shared Python package (e.g. `packages/job_sources`, a uv project used as a path dependency by `apps/mcp`, `apps/crawler` and later `apps/api`). It holds pure parsers plus small clients for:
  - SEEK (public JSON search API `/api/jobsearch/v5/search`)
  - We Work Remotely (RSS)
  - Arc (`__NEXT_DATA__`, category URLs)
  - Himalayas search
  - Remotive search

  Each client returns the crawler's `JobRecord` shape: source, external_id, url, title, company, location, remote, salary_text, tags, posted_at, raw.
- `apps/mcp` tools call the shared clients and keep their current output, plus `external_id`.
- `apps/crawler`: add `seek` to the API-based profile search (`profile_search.py`) using the JSON API. Remove SEEK from the browser runner (`session/sites.py`): the JSON API needs no browser and isn't behind Cloudflare.
- Politeness:
  - an honest User-Agent wherever the endpoint accepts one
  - timeouts, and retries with backoff
  - at most 1 SEEK page per profile per run

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One parser per source; `apps/mcp` and `apps/crawler` tests pass on shared fixtures
- [ ] `python -m job_crawler --profiles` fetches SEEK through the JSON API and links the results to profiles (`profile_jobs`)
- [ ] `job_crawler.session` no longer lists `seek`; docs updated (crawler README, ARCHITECTURE D11)
- [ ] ruff and pytest green in all three projects

## Dependencies
None. Can start now (parallel group C).
